g.text: # the vendor renamed phone and turned balance into a string
In each customer object, balance changed from integer to string, and phone was removed while phone_number was added
with the same string type. The phone to phone_number pair looks like a rename.
The phone to phone_number change is most likely a field rename by the billing API. The balance type change
has no clear explanation in the evidence; a serialization change such as formatting amounts as strings is plausible
Code reading $.data[*].phone will get no value after this change. Code that does arithmetic or numeric
comparison on $.data[*].balance will fail or misbehave now that it is a string. Code reading $.data[*].phone_number
gets a string where it previously had no field.
Update consumers to read $.data[*].phone_number instead of $.data[*].phone, after confirming the rename with
the billing API vendor. Convert balance to a number on read, or ask the vendor whether it is now a decimal string,
and confirm the unit and precision before relying on it.
